show hn: i made a one-click ai ad creator for products
text:
hi hn!i recently built admuseai — a simple ai tool that generates product ad creatives using just one main product image (plus optional reference styles). built in 24 hours thanks to vibe-coding!why i made it:
i noticed that creating good-looking ad creatives often needs a designer or a lot of time. i wanted a faster way to turn product photos into polished ads — no editing skills required.how it works:
- upload a product image- (optional) upload a few reference images for style inspiration- write a short prompt- generate → download your ad creatives!~~ free for limited time ~~no account/signup needed — you can just use it directly!link: https://admuseai.comwould love any feedback — ui/ux thoughts, feature ideas, or anything else! 
thanks for checking it out.
